seg_synapse_nri — EMPROOF wiring op

• 資料種類:labels2d × labels2d × table → table

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.seg_synapse_nri(a, b, synapses, spacing=None, background=0)(要直接呼叫實作,import segcompare; segcompare.seg_synapse_nri(a, b, synapses, spacing=None, background=0);從台帳取用則 opsemproof.get("seg_synapse_nri"))

用法

> 該運算子的說明尚無譯文,以下照原文給出。

Neural reconstruction integrity (Reilly et al. 2018) of candidate b against truth a.

NRI scores the pairs of synapse ends that a reconstruction keeps together. Over the 2n ends (synapses as in seg_synapse_partners; ends on background in the truth are dropped, ends on background in the candidate are singletons), a pair of ends that lies in one truth neuron and one candidate object is a true positive; a pair in one truth neuron but different candidate objects is a false negative (a split); a pair in one candidate object but different truth neurons is a false positive (a merge). nri = 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN) with the pair precision and recall.

Identity (checked inside, fail-closed): with n_ij the contingency table of the ends, TP = sum C(n_ij, 2), TP + FN = sum C(s_i, 2), TP + FP = sum C(t_j, 2), so NRI is exactly 1 - adapted_rand_error of seg_rand taken over the ends (the - N form of the pair counts is 2 C(n, 2)). Both are computed and must agree to 1e-12. Returns nri, precision, recall, tp, fp, fn, n_ends.

Raises ValueError: as seg_wiring_variation; fewer than 2 ends.
